newsitem.title: USA: Dow seen lifted by energy, interest rate mood gels.
newsitem.headline: Dow seen lifted by energy, interest rate mood gels.

text.p: U.S. stocks could open modestly higher on Monday, boosted by energy stocks and a follow-through on Friday's rally.
The calming of swirling interest rate fears into a consensus is also expected to help boost the market.

"We could have a decent follow-through on Friday's gains, but nothing's set in stone," said Larry Wachtel at Prudential Securities. "The Street is becoming convinced the Fed's going to tighten rates and an increase of 25 points is built-in."
